disambiguation: Not a standalone task manager; it is a dedicated panel that organizes tasks already defined by the Tasks plugin.
extras: Supports 13 languages and has a beta release path via BRAT.
intentEvidence: This panel reads the fields Tasks writes on your task lines and puts them to use.
problem: Tasks are scattered across many notes, making it difficult to see what needs to be done based on when it is due.

relations.evidence: This panel reads the fields Tasks writes on your task lines and puts them to use.

summary: A sidebar panel that gathers and organizes tasks from across the vault into time-horizon buckets based on the Getting Things Done methodology.
